To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the exchange rate regime in Nigeria does not promote non oil exports.
trade and exchange rate policy complement each other in promoting non oil export performance of the real sector.
the exchange rate regime and trade policies have not produced the expected results of stimulating non oil exports.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effect of trade policies on non oil exports.
the impact of trade and exchange rate policy on export performance of developing countries.
the effect of trade policies and exchange rate on the real sector export performance of Nigeria.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
trade and exchange rate complement each other in promoting non oil exports in developing countries like Nigeria.
trade policies and exchange rate regimes complement each other in promoting the export performance of developing countries like Nigeria.
trade policies, exchange rate policies complement one another in stimulating non oil export performance.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the exchange rate policy in the country should be geared towards achieving an equilibrium exchange rate regime that will promote non oil export performance.
exchange rate policy is a complement to trade policies in stimulating non-oil export performance.
the government of the day should be able to adopt the appropriate exchange rate regimes that will promote non-oil exports.
The main takeaway from our work is that

trade policy, especially exchange rate policy is not the only factor that affects non oil exports, other factors such as the quality and quantity of the product, the availability of the product in the market and the cost of production are also important.
the exchange rate regime is not a good indicator of the overall export performance of the economy.
exchange rate policy is not a panacea for export promotion, rather a combination of trade and exchange rate policy will enhance export performance.
